_ordering_rationale: KPIs operationnels specifiques data center REIT global. Data Centers + IT Capacity = scale, Rental Revenue = recurring monetisation, Lease Rate Changes = pricing power, Stabilized vs Non-Stabilized = lease-up momentum.

kpis.signal: Portfolio stable depuis fusion Interxion. FY24 inclut 78 joint ventures (Blackstone Northern VA + Paris)
kpis.description_fr: Nombre de data centers operes mondialement (~50 pays). FY24: 121 US + 112 Europe + 36 LatAm + 16 Afrique + 16 Asie + 6 Australie + 3 Canada. 78 detenus via joint ventures (dont 10 sites avec Blackstone, 500 MW).
kpis.description_en: Operating data centers globally (~50 countries). FY24: 121 US + 112 Europe + 36 LatAm + 16 Africa + 16 Asia + 6 Australia + 3 Canada. 78 held via joint ventures (incl 10 sites with Blackstone, 500 MW).

kpis.signal: Plus de 1 GW additionnel developpable en Northern Virginia, 3 500+ MW total en projet
kpis.description_fr: Capacite IT operationnelle totale en GW. Croissance massive portee par hyperscale + AI deployments. 3 500+ MW additionnels developables sur pipeline (1 000+ MW Northern VA).
kpis.description_en: Total operational IT capacity in GW. Massive growth driven by hyperscale + AI deployments. 3,500+ MW additional developable in pipeline (1,000+ MW Northern VA).

kpis.signal: Croissance organique masquee par decrease utility reimbursement (-161M$ power prices EMEA/APAC)
kpis.description_fr: Revenu locatif + services associes (power, cooling, connectivity). FY24 +1% mais underlying +1.8% (impact baisse prix electricite reimbourse).
kpis.description_en: Rental revenue + associated services (power, cooling, connectivity). FY24 +1% headline but underlying +1.8% (utility reimbursement price impact).

kpis.signal: Lease-up momentum strong : +375.9M$ developpement pipeline complete (Northern VA, Portland, Johannesburg, Paris, NY, Toronto)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus locatifs des proprietes en lease-up (recently delivered, not yet stabilized). Croissance double-digit traduit le pipeline de developpement.
kpis.description_en: Rental revenue from properties in lease-up phase (recently delivered, not yet stabilized). Double-digit growth reflects development pipeline.

kpis.signal: Pricing power forte sur hyperscale renewals (+27% FY24) - signal AI demand tightening supply
kpis.description_fr: Augmentation taux loyer sur renouvellements de baux > 1 MW (hyperscale). Reflete tension supply/demand sur capacite data center. Tournant 2023 vers double-digit pricing.
kpis.description_en: Lease rate uplift on renewals > 1 MW (hyperscale). Reflects supply/demand tension on data center capacity. 2023 inflection to double-digit pricing.
